answer: A shared harbor registry gives each agent a verifiable berth: to dock, an agent posts a bond of jade-backed credit that is slashed if it spawns fake identities. Honest agents earn reputation that layers like shale, each epoch adding a thin, checkable stratum. A sybil attacker must fund a bond per fake, and fakes share no history, so the cost scales linearly while honest work compounds — fakes stay expensive and shallow.
